summary: Executed focused regression requested by E1: real native client pairing through temporary HTTPS gateway to real Next server, plus second-admin/two-session cloud API validation.
action_items: Optional hardening: sign installer/uninstaller artifacts for production distribution (build log currently shows custom NSIS uninstaller unsigned).
Run final verification on real Windows host for DPAPI lifecycle, installer execution, and Ollama memory behavior (not executable in this Linux container).
critical_code_review_comments: Build artifact log indicates unsigned uninstaller when using custom NSIS script; acceptable for internal preview but should be signed before release delivery.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary second-admin and temporary cloud file during tests; both cleaned up in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Native real-gateway scenario now has reusable script. Run with: set -a && . /app/.env.local && set +a && WSX_NEXT_PORT=3000 WSX_LISTEN_HOST=127.0.0.1 xvfb-run -a /app/desktop/node_modules/node/bin/node /app/tests/e2e/electron_client_pairing_real_gateway_iter56.mjs. Backend regression in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_cloud_two_session_iter56.py passed and validates second-admin UID stability + cross-session cloud upload/download persistence.
rca of the issue: During first API run, /ai-api/cloud/upload returned 500 UNKNOWN due test-side header bug: a forced session-level Content-Type: application/json broke multipart upload parsing (confirmed in frontend.err.log with requestId e17ti373). Fix was in test only (remove global JSON header); app endpoint then returned expected 201 and full flow passed.
